_comment: Every index FinPulse needs, per collection. Source of truth for migration/indexes.py (inspect/apply). Java declares users/uploaded_documents/processing_jobs/transactions through annotations; the Python worker creates transactions + reports. tests/test_java_contract.py checks the Java annotations against this file; tests/test_index_contract.py checks the worker's lists. Matching is by key pattern + uniqueness: an existing index with the same keys but another NAME is accepted as equivalent (Spring names a single-field @Indexed after the field).
